title: Asleep at the Wheel
description: Grammy-winning Western swing institution Asleep at the Wheel brings its Texas dancehall sound to the historic Bijou Theatre. Expect fiddle-driven standards and a half-century of road-tested showmanship.

title: Movie on the Lawn: National Treasure
description: Bring a blanket to the Kern's event lawn for an outdoor screening of National Treasure. Food hall vendors and the bar stay open through the show.

title: Weekday Movie Massacre: Poltergeist
location: 213 E 5th Ave STE A, Knoxville, TN 37917
description: Xul Beer's weekly horror screening series takes on Poltergeist. Free to attend with beer available from the taproom.

title: Ijams Sunset Socials: Katsura Sunshine Rakugo
description: Katsura Sunshine brings the 400-year-old Japanese comic storytelling art of Rakugo to the Ijams Sunset Socials series. An evening of solo comedic performance in a woodland setting.

title: Trail Running 101 Q&A with Fleet Feet
description: An open Q&A on trail running basics followed by a group walk/run at 6:30pm. A preview of Fleet Feet's four-week trail training program, open to beginner and experienced runners alike.

title: Concerts on the Square: Variety Thursdays with Square Dancing
description: Free live music on Market Square with square dancing called from the stage. Bring a chair or dance on the bricks.

title: Knoxville Symphony Orchestra: Gershwin's American in Paris
description: The Knoxville Symphony Orchestra performs Gershwin's An American in Paris at the Tennessee Theatre. A jazz-inflected program in one of the South's great movie palaces.

title: Judah & The Lion with Carriers and kylekelly
description: Nashville folk-rock outfit Judah & The Lion headline The Mill & Mine with support from Carriers and kylekelly. Standing room, 18 and up.

title: Knoxville Theatre Club Presents: Hedda Gabler
description: Knoxville Theatre Club stages Ibsen's Hedda Gabler at the Borderland Playhouse on Sevier Avenue. The run continues through the weekend; reservations recommended.

title: End of Summer Party: Goblin House, UKG, 140 and DNB
description: Knoxville's electronic scene closes out the season at Alliance Brewing with goblin house, UK garage, 140 and drum and bass sets. Late-night dancing in the Sevier Avenue taproom.

title: Ho-Down Social with Cowtown Studios
description: Classic country line dancing and two-stepping on the Kern's event lawn with a DJ, full bar and a mechanical bull. Lessons run 8 to 9pm and social dancing until 11.

title: Different Drum: A Tribute to Linda Ronstadt
description: A full-band tribute to Linda Ronstadt's catalog at Barley's in the Old City. Five dollars at the door, 21 and up.

title: Four Leaf Peat
description: Knoxville's own Four Leaf Peat play Irish folk and traditional tunes at Boyd's Jig & Reel. Free, 21 and up, with the deepest whisky list in the Old City.

title: Planet Doom House Night with Doomsayer
description: Planet Doom takes over Scruffy City Hall for a night of tech house and bass house with Doomsayer and guests. Late-night dancing just off Market Square.

title: Planet Doom: Pink is Punk Emo Night
description: Emo hits, dubstep and more from Mockingbird and TJO at The Pink Cactus. Planet Doom's recurring Pink is Punk night, 18 and up.

title: Tennessee Terror Corps: Tommy Lewis, Healng, Blaine Mason, Rutam and Tiny
description: Tennessee Terror Corps presents a techno and hard dance showcase at Sassy Ann's with Tommy Lewis, Healng, Blaine Mason, Rutam and Tiny. Twenty dollars, 21 and up.

title: Bitchin Bajas with Unwed Sailor and Banquet
description: Chicago drone-synth trio Bitchin Bajas headline the Pilot Light with Unwed Sailor and Banquet. Minimal, meditative and loud in a very small room.

title: Son Volt with Shannon McNally
description: Jay Farrar's Son Volt bring three decades of alt-country to the Bijou, with Shannon McNally opening.

title: Destiny Bond and Basic Needs with Faetrap and Crucial Few
description: A touring hardcore bill at the Karns Community Center with Destiny Bond, Basic Needs, Faetrap and Crucial Few. All ages, ten dollars for under-18s.

title: Moon Market
description: New Moon Rising's monthly market on North Central with makers, vintage sellers and metaphysical goods. Free to browse.

title: EDM Cat Party: Kitty Pawty
description: Circuit Broad, DJ Batzy and DJ KandyAnn bring electronic dance music to Knoxville's cat cafe. Dance with the resident cats; RSVP recommended.

title: The Circus Under the Moon at Ijams
description: An outdoor circus performance on the Ijams grounds under the night sky, with aerialists and acrobats. Reservations required; blankets and chairs welcome.

title: ZZ Top Notch
description: A full ZZ Top tribute set at Open Chord in West Knoxville. Beards, boogie and all the hits, all ages.

title: Skankbanger
description: Eighties metal tribute band Skankbanger take the Scruffy City Hall stage for a late Saturday set on Market Square.

title: Old City Market
description: The Sunday market fills the 100 block of West Jackson from Central to the train tracks with local makers, food and vintage sellers. Free to wander.

title: Rain Garden Ceremony
description: The Museum of Infinite Outcomes, Tremont and Discover Life in America host interactive art and science activities for the whole family at the Dodson Avenue rain garden built with local educators last fall. Where does your water come from? What is the ground? Come find out.

title: Bijou Imagination Series: The Adventures of Tortoise and Hare
description: A family matinee in the Bijou's Imagination Series retelling the classic fable with puppetry and live performance. Short enough for small attention spans.

title: Buffalo Traffic Jam with Elias Hix and Lydia Maes
description: Buffalo Traffic Jam bring the Pictures of You tour to The Mill & Mine with Elias Hix and Lydia Maes. Eighteen and up.

title: Texas Hippie Coalition with Below 7 and Downshift
description: Red dirt metal from Texas Hippie Coalition at Open Chord, with Below 7, Downshift and The Lucky Bastards opening. All ages.

title: Old City Night Market
description: North Central Street closes from Jackson Avenue to the train tracks for the Old City Night Market, with makers, food trucks, music and late browsing. Free to attend.

title: Boyd's Jig & Reel 15 Year Anniversary Old Time Jam
description: Sarah Pirkle's weekly old time jam doubles as Boyd's Jig & Reel's fifteenth anniversary party. Free and all ages; bring an instrument or just listen.

title: The Home Team: The Crucible of Life II
description: The Home Team bring The Crucible of Life II to The Mill & Mine for a Tuesday night in the Old City.

title: Kelsey's Woods
description: Kelsey's Woods play a late Saturday set at Barley's in the Old City.

title: Honky Tonk Thursday at Barley's
description: Barley's weekly Honky Tonk Thursday in the Old City, with rotating country and honky tonk acts, cheap cover and pizza until late.

title: CHROMA: Image & Sound Festival
description: Two days, six live scores and 65 films at Knoxville's experimental film and music festival. Each program is conceived as a dialogue between moving image and live ambient and experimental music.

title: First Friday ArtWalk
description: Downtown galleries and studios stay open late on the first Friday of every month. New exhibits open at the Emporium Center and along Gay Street, with free admission throughout.

title: Cowtown Weekly Dance Lessons
description: Cowtown Studios' weekly country dance lessons, with beginners at noon and intermediates at 1pm. Ten dollars a head.

title: Knox Small Press Fest Publisher's Fair
description: Local writers, poets, artists and publishers show and sell their work at the Emporium Center for Knox Small Press Fest's Publishers Fair. Saturday and Sunday afternoon, free to browse.

title: Knoxville Ice Bears Opening Night
location: 500 Howard Baker Jr Ave, Knoxville, TN 37915
description: The Ice Bears open their 25th season against the Evansville Thunderbolts at the Civic Coliseum. Puck drops at 7:30pm for a night of SPHL hockey and anniversary celebrations.

title: Kern's Fall Festival
description: Kern's celebrates the season with local vendors, fall activities and line dancing with Cowtown Studios from 2 to 3pm. Free, family friendly and full of fall vibes.

title: KMA: Roots of Appalachia with Daniel Kimbro
location: 1050 Worlds Fair Park Dr, Knoxville, TN 37916
description: Grammy-nominated East Tennessee musician Daniel Kimbro performs outdoors at the Knoxville Museum of Art with support from Madison Casey and Shane Smith. Free BBQ, a cash bar, and free admission for all.

title: Hocus Pocus: Movies on the Lawn
description: Time to light the black flame candle. Hocus Pocus screens on the Kern's event lawn with the Plant Trolley open for browsing.
